_note: USD per 1,000,000 tokens. Used ONLY to estimate cost in the [llm] usage log line; nothing is billed or limited from this file. Edit it when a provider's price changes, and check each number against the provider's pricing page. A model that is not listed is logged with its tokens and no cost.
_dryRunNote: What ONE real-model call is assumed to use when an eval or recon script prints its dry-run estimate (tests/eval/realModel.ts). From the OpenAI usage page, 2026-10: about 900 output tokens a request on gpt-5, 87.6% of input cached. An estimate for planning-sized calls, not a measurement of any one script.
